resources.string: Unlock with your device PIN, pattern, password or biometrics, or with the launcher PIN if you set one.
Ask for the system lock or the launcher PIN before showing call recordings. On by default.
Each file is stored with AES-256-GCM. The key stays in the Android Keystore. Playback decrypts a temporary copy.
Do not require lock to open Files
Adds a .nomedia file in the call recordings folder so galleries and Telos Media skip it. Off by default. Call recordings already live in private encrypted storage; this is an extra marker.
